prompt:
Rotoscoped animation sheet for a hand-drawn 2D adventure game: fourteen drawings of the same character, traced over a pose template and finished as traditional ink-and-paint animation cels.

The first reference image is the pose template, rendered from a 3D model: fourteen grey figures in two rows. The upper row is a walk cycle to the right in strict side view (eight phases), the lower row is one gesture in six phases: the character lifts the parcel from under his arm and holds it out in front of him, as if handing it to someone on the right, with a small bow. Trace this template as if on a clear animation cel laid on top of it: every figure stays exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is; the outline of every drawing follows the outline of its template figure closely, only cleaned up into a hand-drawn line. Keep each pose exactly: head angle, body lean, the position of both legs and both feet, both arms, the paws, the parcel, the satchel and the flying scarf end. The feet of each row stand on the same ground line as in the template. Keep the order of the figures, do not add, remove, merge, mirror or swap any figure; the darker grey limbs in the template are the far leg and the far arm and stay behind the body. Take only layout, poses and proportions from the template, never its grey tones or its smooth 3D shading.

The second reference image only shows the costume, the face and the colours of the character: do not copy its drawing style, its fur texture, its soft shading or its three-view layout.

Drawing technique: traditional ink-and-paint animation cels as in classic hand-drawn cartoons. A clean, confident, dark brown-black ink outline of even weight around every shape, a little thicker on the outer silhouette; inner lines only where shapes meet or overlap (face stripes, cap brim, vest edge, sleeves, scarf, the arm in front of the body, the near leg in front of the far leg, the parcel string). Every area is one flat, opaque cel paint colour, and each colour has exactly one darker shadow tone in a hard-edged shape on the side away from the light (light from the upper left). No gradients, no soft shading, no texture, no fur strands, no brush marks, no highlights except one small white catchlight in the eye. Colours: cap and vest dark green, shirt cream, scarf red, satchel and strap brown, brass buttons, parcel light brown with a cream string, the dark fur a mid charcoal grey that is clearly lighter than the ink line, the light fur warm white. All fourteen drawings must show the identical costume, colours and line weight, like one animator's cleaned-up cels. It must look like hand-inked animation cels: not a 3D render, not a painting, not a vector icon.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Each figure isolated on a fully transparent background, with clear empty space between the figures; no ground line, no cast shadow, no frame or cell borders, no labels, nothing cut off at the edge of the sheet.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Hand-inked background painting for a 2D adventure game, traced over a layout reference.

The reference image is a flat-coloured 3D layout render of the scene with thin ink lines. Trace it as if on a clear sheet laid on top of it: keep the camera, the horizon, the cottage, the barrels, the bollards, the fishing boat, the wooden jetty, the lantern post with its lantern, the rocky headland and the lighthouse exactly where they are and exactly as large as they are, and keep the paved quay in the foreground where it is, seen from the same low viewpoint. Take only the layout from the reference, never its flat 3D colours, its lilac placeholder sky or its rigid low-poly shapes: redraw everything by hand.

Style: background art of a classic hand-drawn animated film. Dark brown ink outlines of lively, varying weight around buildings, boats and props, slightly irregular hand-drawn shapes, flat colour areas with simple painted shading in two or three tones per surface, few details, large calm shapes; the paving of the quay as a few loosely drawn flagstones that fade out towards the bottom edge. A painted dusk sky: deep blue-violet above, low soft clouds, a warm orange band of light at the horizon, the first stars. Teal-blue calm sea with a few light streaks. The cottage windows and the lantern glow warm yellow. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a postcard, not a vector graphic.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars. Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites. The lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing spot without any beam, no smoke from the chimney and no birds in the sky (all three are animated separately).

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
